windows.text: Paris, France, 23 September 2026 – The French General Directorate for Armament (DGA) has awarded Airbus, through its subsidiary Airbus Cybersecurity SAS , the 25-year PARACOM contract to supply advanced cybersecurity gateways for the networks of the French Ministry of the Armed Forces and Veterans’ Affairs. Following a competitive tender, the agreement covers the end-to-end design development, production, and long-term operational maintenance of the gateways.

Once deployed across the armed forces and the directorates and departments of the Ministry of the Armed Forces and Veterans’ Affairs, the PARACOM gateways will be a cornerstone of the Ministry’s cybersecurity, enabling secure, filtered data exchanges between networks and information systems with different levels of classification or sensitivity. PARACOM will be approved and certified to cover a range of data exchanges between ‘secret’ and ‘unclassified’ levels.
